title: What if the Sun went out?
hook: What if the Sun went out right now?
objection: Wait, wouldn't we see it instantly?
cta: Would you survive the first year?

beats.caption: The Sun just went out
beats.vo: What if the Sun went out right now?

beats.caption: Nothing happens. Yet.
beats.vo: For eight minutes, nothing happens. The last sunlight is still on its way to us.
beats.fact_source: NASA: sunlight takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to reach Earth
